config.nvmPath: Windows only. Absolute path to `nvm.exe`. Leave empty to auto-detect from `NVM_HOME` or `PATH`.
config.nvmDir: macOS / Linux only. Path to the nvm directory (`NVM_DIR`). Leave empty to auto-detect from `NVM_DIR` or `~/.nvm`.
config.autoSwitch: Auto-switch the active Node.js version from `.nvmrc` / `.node-version` / `package.json` `engines.node` when a workspace is opened. Set globally or per workspace.
config.askWhenAutoSwitchOff: Ask before switching when auto-switch is disabled.
config.registryAdvanced: Resolve the global npm registry by running `npm config get registry` (accurate, includes environment variables) instead of only reading `~/.npmrc`.
config.switchMode: How a version switch is applied. `auto`: try `nvm use` and fall back to VS Code terminals when it needs admin rights. `system`: always use `nvm use` (global symlink). `terminal`: only switch inside VS Code terminals — no admin rights needed.
config.nodeVersionsRoots: Extra directories scanned for Node.js installations when nvm is not available. Each may contain version folders (`v22.16.0`, `node@22`) or be a Node.js installation itself.
config.title: NVM Manager
